entries.claim: Scala 3.8.4 is the exact stable feature release used by the Scala lane and is not described as LTS.
entries.problemRelevance: Defines language semantics, warnings, optimizer flags, and SemanticDB compatibility.
entries.correctnessRisk: A compiler drift would invalidate feature, lint, and floating-point qualification.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Pinned explicitly by Scala CLI directives and asserted before every build.
requiredLint: Exact stable hard-warning profile and per-flag capability smoke.
requiredTests: Compiler identity plus A/B/C full correctness.
requiredBenchmark: Only the prequalified selected profile may enter scored timing.
entries.provenFallback: No compiler fallback inside this contract; report BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN.
assumptions: Scala CLI runs with the already verified system JDK.

entries.claim: Scala CLI 1.15.0 is the exact project-scoped build and JMH integration launcher.
entries.problemRelevance: Pins dependency resolution, compiler invocation, test execution, and experimental JMH integration.
entries.correctnessRisk: Using a PATH fallback or floating version can change dependency or command semantics.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Compressed and executable SHA-256 values are frozen in the approved setup record.
requiredLint: Assert CLI version, binary SHA, and directive pins before execution.
requiredTests: Minimal compile, test, and native JMH JSON smoke.
requiredBenchmark: Invoke exact binary with --server=false, --jvm system, and frozen JMH arguments.
entries.provenFallback: No alternate launcher is permitted without a new contract.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Official GitHub release page and public binary checksum audit.
assumptions: The user provides the exact executable path in readiness evidence.

entries.claim: Eclipse Temurin JDK 25.0.3+9 is the exact JVM and Java release target for the Scala lane.
entries.problemRelevance: JVM identity affects compilation, runtime behavior, and JMH results.
entries.correctnessRisk: Vendor or patch drift invalidates same-subject and same-host evidence.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Scala 3 JDK compatibility documentation and --release:25 are frozen.
requiredLint: Assert JAVA_HOME release metadata and invoked java.home identity.
requiredTests: Compile and runtime vendor, version, VM, and java.home assertions.
requiredBenchmark: Capture effective JVM arguments and relevant system properties.

entries.claim: Scalafmt 3.11.4 is the exact non-mutating formatter and byte-idempotence gate.
entries.problemRelevance: Keeps source formatting deterministic across main, test, benchmark, and profile inputs.
entries.correctnessRisk: Silent formatter downgrade or config discovery drift changes the tracked source subject.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Exact nested config, Scala 3 dialect, LF, and explicit version are required.
requiredLint: Parse, format, second-pass byte idempotence, and non-mutating --check.
requiredBenchmark: Formatted source-tree hash must equal the benchmark subject input hash.
entries.provenFallback: No downgrade; a reproducible formatter defect is BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN.
assumptions: Formatting is never applied automatically in CI.

entries.claim: Standalone Scalafix 0.14.7 is the mandatory syntactic lint runner; Scala CLI fix integration is not the hard path.
entries.problemRelevance: Enforces DisableSyntax and conditionally qualifies ExplicitResultTypes.
entries.correctnessRisk: Silent semantic-rule skip or auto rewrite could hide unsupported source.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Exact external executable path, version, and SHA are readiness inputs.
requiredLint: DisableSyntax hard gate and typed ExplicitResultTypes disposition.
requiredTests: Clean and forbidden-syntax negative fixtures plus exact SemanticDB smoke.
requiredBenchmark: No timing input; lint result and source hashes qualify the benchmark subject.
entries.provenFallback: If semantic qualification fails, use explicit source annotations and public-boundary audit while keeping syntactic gates.
assumptions: The standalone runner is user-provided and not bootstrapped by the agent.

entries.claim: JMH 1.37 supplies the Scala native kernel timer after exact capability and effective-JVM-argument qualification.
entries.problemRelevance: Reports native average time excluding setup, decode, process start, and result writing.
entries.correctnessRisk: Annotations or runtime JVM arguments can override the frozen benchmark plan.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Scala CLI integration is experimental and therefore must pass the exact minimal native JSON smoke.
requiredLint: Exact annotation/value policy and no plan-overriding annotation or CLI JVM argument.
requiredTests: Compile, list, exact one case, execute, and native JSON validation.
requiredBenchmark: AverageTime, ns, one thread, frozen forks/warmup/measurement, exact selectors.
entries.provenFallback: Repair the pinned integration before timing; do not substitute another harness.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Official OpenJDK benchmark harness project documentation.
assumptions: Capability smoke is complete before full kernel implementation.

entries.claim: Stackage LTS 24.50 with GHC 9.10.3 is the authoritative tested-together Haskell correctness and performance basis.
entries.problemRelevance: Pins compiler, packages, build plan, and the scored Haskell subject.
entries.correctnessRisk: Mixing latest Hackage versions or a different compiler confounds dependency and compiler effects.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Stack yaml, lock, compiler-check match-exact, system-ghc, and no-install-ghc are frozen.
requiredLint: Exact hard warning, extension, module-safety, and dependency-native-edge policies.
requiredTests: Baseline and optimized complete correctness plus toolchain and plan equality.
requiredBenchmark: Only the frozen selector's chosen -O0 -fasm or -O2 -fasm profile is scored.
entries.provenFallback: baseline-o0-fasm on the same authoritative compiler and snapshot.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Public Stackage snapshot and official GHC release documentation.
assumptions: All non-boot sources, versions, and approved flags are lock-verified.

entries.claim: GHC 9.14.1 is the latest official stable and first GHC LTS compiler, used only in the required non-scoring compatibility lane.
entries.problemRelevance: Exposes future compiler compatibility while preserving the authoritative tested package set.
entries.correctnessRisk: Boot-set replacement and frozen dependency bounds can be mistaken for candidate source failure.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Typed result classification and exact phase closure distinguish dependency, candidate, environment, and unclassified failures.
requiredLint: No forbidden override and exact non-boot equality across lanes.
requiredTests: Mandatory dependency attempt and full replay after successful solve.
entries.provenFallback: Authoritative GHC 9.10.3 remains unchanged; only a proven frozen-dependency incompatibility is non-blocking.
assumptions: The compatibility compiler and boot set may differ; non-boot inputs may not.

entries.claim: Stack 3.11.1 is installed through the exact GHCup-managed channel and its installed binary is distinct from the upstream comparison-only standalone asset.
entries.problemRelevance: Resolves and builds the authoritative and compatibility package plans reproducibly.
entries.correctnessRisk: Conflating archive, installed-binary, and upstream standalone hashes invalidates provenance.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Exact metadata commit, archive URI/SHA, portable path ID, installed SHA, and numeric version are frozen.
requiredLint: Structured provenance lock equality and forbidden Stack override-key audit.
requiredTests: whereis path mapping, binary SHA/version, metadata evidence digest, yaml/lock and plan tests.
requiredBenchmark: Every native block reasserts exact Stack and merged provenance identity.
entries.provenFallback: No direct standalone Stack asset may replace the approved installed provenance.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Official Stack release plus GHCup metadata and managed bindist records.
assumptions: The user provides the absolute path mapping for GHCUP_STACK_3_11_1.

entries.claim: Exact user-provided HLint 3.10 and stylish-haskell 0.15.1.0 binaries form non-mutating full-source lint and format gates.
entries.problemRelevance: Rejects partial and unsafe source and preserves deterministic formatting across all components.
entries.correctnessRisk: Source-local ignores, auto rewrite, or floating tools can hide unsupported source or alter the benchmark subject.
entries.toolingCompatibility: Exact executable versions and SHA values are readiness inputs; formatter config uses GHC2024 and LF.
requiredLint: All hints are gated; exceptions are central, typed, narrow, tested, owned, and non-stale.
requiredTests: Qualified and aliased partial-function negatives plus misformatting and input-set equality.
requiredBenchmark: No timing input; source hashes qualify the exact benchmark subject.
entries.provenFallback: No floating or auto-installed linter and formatter replacements.
entries.licenseAccessNote: Public Stackage and Hackage package documentation.
assumptions: The user provides exact tool paths and executable hashes.
